description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations, validation rules, and data normalization for employee immigration records within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI, covering CRUD operations, validation rules, and data normalization in the HRM system.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordService
methods.description: Tests that the EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI correctly returns an instance of EmployeeImmigrationRecordService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee immigration record and its normalization output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for fetching a single employee immigration record.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of an employee immigration record and proper handling of not found exceptions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for deleting records.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing immigration record and checks the response normalization and meta data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for updating an immigration record.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new employee immigration record and verifies the response normalization and meta data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for creating a new record.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple immigration records for an employee and their normalization output along with meta data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for fetching all immigration records for an employee.
